titulo: Why Do the RICH Stay Rich? 🐔 #shorts
descripcion:
What if all the money in the world disappeared tomorrow and everyone got just two chickens? One group eats them, one eats the eggs… and one lets the eggs hatch. A year later, the world splits into three again. The difference was never what they were given.

What would YOU do with your two chickens? Tell me in the comments 👇
